function f(x: string | number, y: string | number) {
  const both = typeof x === "string" && typeof y === "string";
  if (both) return x.length + y.length;
  let z: string | number = x;
  const isStr = typeof z === "string";
  z = 1;
  if (isStr) return z.length;
  return 0;
}
console.log(f("a", "b"));
